privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What data we collect, why, how long we keep it, and how to exercise your rights.

blocks.text: The controller of the personal data collected on this website is Aman & Partners: [À COMPLÉTER — company name, legal form, address and company number, as in the legal notice].
For any question about your data, you can write to us at [À COMPLÉTER].
We only collect the data you send us through the website's forms, along with some technical data needed to process them:

items: Contact form: name, company (optional), email address, phone (optional) and message.

Project request: last name, first name, company (optional), email address, phone (optional), country, information about your project (type, description, estimated budget, timeline, whether specifications and a design exist) and, where applicable, the document you attach.

Partner application: name or agency name, email address, country, status, availability, specialties, technologies, years of experience and, where applicable, daily rate, links (portfolio, LinkedIn, GitHub) and message.

For every form: the website language, the date and time of your consent, and the source of your visit (advertising campaign parameters present in the address, such as utm_source). Ad click identifiers (gclid, fbclid) are only kept if you have accepted advertising cookies.

Technical data: to limit abusive submissions, your IP address is turned into an irreversible fingerprint, kept for no more than 24 hours; the IP address itself is never stored. The anti-bot check (Cloudflare Turnstile) also processes technical information about your browser.

blocks.text: Please do not send any sensitive data (health, opinions, etc.) in your messages or documents.

blocks.text: Your data is intended for Aman & Partners. It is never sold or rented. To run the website, we use the following processors, bound by data protection commitments:

blocks.text: When your project is entrusted to a provider from our network (freelancer or agency), we only share the information needed to deliver it, under a confidentiality commitment. Aman & Partners remains your point of contact.

Some of our processors are based outside the European Union or may access data from there. These transfers are covered by the safeguards provided for by the GDPR: the European Commission's adequacy decision for Switzerland, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework for certified providers and, failing that, the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission.

rows: Messages, project requests and applications with no follow-up, with their internal notes and attached documents
Duration of the contractual relationship, then statutory periods (7 years for accounting records)

blocks.text: Once these periods have ended, the data is deleted or anonymised.
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights over your data:

items: Right of access: to know what data we hold about you and obtain a copy.
Right to rectification: to have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
Right to erasure: to request the deletion of your data, unless we must keep it to comply with a legal obligation.
Right to restriction of processing: to request that the use of your data be temporarily suspended.
Right to object: to object to processing based on our legitimate interest.
Right to data portability: to receive the data you provided in a structured, commonly used format.
Right to withdraw your consent at any time, for analytics and advertising cookies, without affecting processing already carried out.

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, write to us at [À COMPLÉTER]. We will reply within one month. If we have reasonable doubts about your identity, we may ask you for additional information.

If you believe that the processing of your data does not comply with the regulations, you can lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority: rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels, www.dataprotectionauthority.be.
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including:

items: encrypted exchanges between your browser and the website (HTTPS);
access to requests restricted to Aman & Partners, protected by secure authentication;
attached documents that are never public, only accessible through temporary links;
protection against automated submissions, without storing IP addresses;
storage of requests and documents in the European Union.

blocks.text: Your data is not subject to any fully automated decision or profiling producing legal effects concerning you. Every request is reviewed by a person.
This policy may be updated, in particular if the website or the regulations change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: The cookies used on the website, what they are for, how long they last, and how to change your choice at any time.
cookies.manageText: You can accept or refuse analytics and advertising cookies at any time.

blocks.text: A cookie is a small file placed on your device when you visit a website. It allows the website to remember information, such as your preferences, or to measure its traffic. This policy also covers similar technologies, such as the browser's local storage.
On your first visit, a banner lets you accept, refuse or customise cookies, just as easily. Only cookies necessary for the website to work are used without your consent.

No analytics or advertising script (Google, Meta) is loaded before you give your consent. Your choice is kept for 6 months, after which the banner is shown again. You can change it at any time with the button at the bottom of this page, or the “Manage cookies” link in the footer of every page.
These cookies are essential for the website to work securely. They do not require your consent.

rows: Remembering your display preference (light or dark theme)
Sign-in session for the administration area, reserved for Aman & Partners; never set for visitors
Checking that forms are sent by a person and not by a bot

blocks.text: With your consent, these cookies help us understand how the website is used (pages viewed, journeys, devices), in order to improve it.

rows: Keeping the state of the current visit

blocks.text: With your consent, these cookies allow us to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns on Google, Facebook and Instagram, that is, to know how many requests each campaign brings us.

rows: Measuring conversions from our Google ads
Measuring the effectiveness of our ads on Facebook and Instagram

blocks.text: Google and Meta may also set cookies on their own domains, under their own policies, which we invite you to read.
You can also set your browser to block or delete cookies. Blocking necessary cookies may however prevent some features of the website from working, such as sending forms.
To find out more about how your personal data is processed and about your rights, see our privacy policy.
